summary: E2E frontend test of teamwork Lot items (approvals + inbox + portefeuilles heatmap + notif prefs + weekly review). Result: 6/8 flows PASS, 1 FAIL (manager inbox mention missing), 1 partial (notif defaults differ from spec). CRITICAL INGRESS BUG DISCOVERED: /approvals and /portefeuilles return 404 on direct navigation (raw index.html shell without JS bundle) — only client-side <Link> navigation works, so any hard refresh / shared link / deep-link to those routes crashes UX. All other pages tested (/, /login, /tournee, /clients, /orders, /stock, /paiements, /settings, /profile, /reports, /products) return 200.

minor.issue: After commercial creates an approval, the target manager (Marie M., owner) sees NO inbox mention and NO unread badge, yet the approval is visible in /approvals pending. Panel shows 'Aucune mention en attente'. Spec expects mention '[Validation demandée · remise]'. Commercial DOES receive the return mention '[Validation approved · remise]' correctly, so the return leg works but the outbound-to-approver leg does not.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <a> nested inside <a>. inbox-item Link (li -> Link to='/') is rendered inside the profile nav Link (a href='/profile') — invalid HTML. Reproducible on every login when badge > 0.

Spec: silence_start='20:00', silence_end='08:00'. Actual defaults observed for manager: silence_start='22:00', silence_end='07:00' (silence_sundays checked = OK). Persistence works (21:00 saved and reloaded correctly), only initial default values differ from PRD.

integration_issues.issue: GET /approvals and GET /portefeuilles from ingress return HTTP 404 with raw unprocessed index.html template (contains literal '%PUBLIC_URL%' placeholders, no /static/js/bundle.js script tag). Root cause: SPA history-fallback whitelist on the ingress/edge does not include these two new routes. Impact: users cannot reload the page, bookmark, or share a link to these views. Client-side <Link> navigation from a route that IS whitelisted works fine — that is how we validated all functional flows.
See backend_issues.minor above — the outbound '[Validation demandée · remise]' mention is not delivered to the manager's inbox panel.

issues: Legend renders all 4 keywords (Capacité/Équilibré/Au-dessus/Surchargé). With demo data (1 commercial has 4 clients, others 0) no overload → suggestions banner correctly hidden with message 'Portefeuilles équilibrés. Aucune suggestion.' as documented.

action_items: P0 INGRESS: whitelist /approvals and /portefeuilles (and any future new routes) in the SPA history-fallback config so direct navigation / hard refresh return the full built index.html with the /static/js/bundle.js tag. Curl comparison: /tournee -> 200 (has bundle.js), /approvals -> 404 (raw template with %PUBLIC_URL%).

P1 BACKEND: investigate why /api/approvals POST does not create an inbox mention for the assigned approver (manager). The reverse path (approver -> requester on approve) works. Likely a missing @mention insert or a wrong recipient user_id when kind='remise' with no establishment_id (context.pct only).

P2 FRONTEND: fix InboxDropdown.jsx line 76-78 — the inbox-item <Link to='/'> is rendered as a descendant of the profile nav <a href='/profile'>. Move the InboxDropdown out of the profile Link OR change the profile wrapper from <a>/<Link> to a <button>.
P3 UX: align default notif silence window with PRD (start=20:00, end=08:00) OR update PRD to match current defaults (22:00/07:00).
critical_code_review_comments: SPA route whitelist should be dynamic (regex-based on any authenticated path) rather than a hand-maintained list — this is the second time a new route ships broken on direct navigation (see iteration_22 /paiements-related notes).
InboxDropdown is inserted inside a Link/anchor in Layout.jsx creating nested <a> — anchors should never contain other interactive anchors. Extract the dropdown to a sibling of the profile link.

Approvals mention creation should assert a mention row is created for the approver in the same transaction as the approval; a backend integration test with a fresh approval + inbox check would catch this regression.

success_rate.frontend: TEST1 PASS, TEST2 FAIL (mention not delivered), TEST3 PASS, TEST4 PASS, TEST5 PASS, TEST6 SKIPPED (no unassigned clients in demo data), TEST7 PASS (persistence OK; defaults differ from PRD), TEST8 PASS (page loads; card not visible = expected non-Monday). 6/8 flows fully green.

Additional test data from prior runs already exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: /approvals and /portefeuilles cannot be reached by page.goto() — they return 404 with the raw index.html template (curl proves it). To test these routes with Playwright, use a client-side navigation trick: login/land on / (or /tournee), then execute `window.history.pushState({}, '', '/approvals'); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'))`. That is what made the tests pass. Also, on first login as manager an onboarding tour modal appears and blocks approval-new-submit — dismiss it via the X button (svg.lucide-x inside a button) before interacting. Manager inbox showed 'Aucune mention en attente' even after commercial submitted a new remise approval — confirmed backend gap. Commercial return mention '[Validation approved · remise]' works fine (badge=4 after approve).

rca_of_the_issue.route_404: The frontend ingress (or webpack dev server historyApiFallback config) enumerates SPA routes explicitly. Routes /approvals and /portefeuilles were added to React Router (App.js lines 182-183) but not to the ingress whitelist. curl -s /approvals returns the raw public/index.html template (7572 bytes with literal '%PUBLIC_URL%' placeholders and NO /static/js/bundle.js) with HTTP 404. Fix: add these routes (or a wildcard/regex) to the ingress SPA fallback list so any unmatched authenticated path falls back to the compiled index.html with the bundle script tag injected.
rca_of_the_issue.manager_mention_missing: After POST /approvals succeeds and creates the approval visible to the manager in /approvals list, no @mention row is inserted for that manager. Verified by checking [data-testid=inbox-badge] absent and panel innerText = 'Aucune mention en attente.' on Marie M. account. The reverse (approver -> requester on PATCH /approvals/{id} status=approved) does insert the mention correctly (commercial badge shows 4, panel lists the entries).
